<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Solfejo – método Bohumil Med</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Nunito:wght@600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
--bg:#fff;--card:#fff;--fg:#4b4b4b;--mute:#8a8a8a;--line:#3c3c3c;--acc:#1cb0f6;--accd:#1899d6;--ok:#58cc02;--okd:#58a700;--bad:#ff4b4b;--bd:#e5e5e5;--warm:#ff9600;--warmd:#cc7800;color-scheme:light}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#131f24;--card:#1f2c34;--fg:#e8eef1;--mute:#8fa1ab;--line:#d7e0e5;--bd:#37464f;color-scheme:dark}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#131f24;--card:#1f2c34;--fg:#e8eef1;--mute:#8fa1ab;--line:#d7e0e5;--bd:#37464f;color-scheme:dark}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:Nunito,"DIN Round Pro",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;font-weight:700}
main{max-width:820px;margin:0 auto;padding:18px 14px 40px}
h1{font-size:1.7rem;font-weight:900;color:var(--ok);margin:0 0 4px}h2{font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:900;margin:0 0 12px}
.sub,.mute{color:var(--mute);font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600}
.card{background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--bd);border-radius:18px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:14px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(250px,1fr));gap:12px}
.mod{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;text-align:left;width:100%;padding:12px;border-radius:18px;border:2px solid var(--bd);border-bottom-width:5px;background:var(--card);color:var(--fg);cursor:pointer;font:inherit;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0}
.mod:hover{border-color:var(--acc)}.mod.lk{opacity:.55}
.mod b{display:block;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:800;line-height:1.25;margin-bottom:3px}
.mod .mute{display:block;font-size:.78rem}
.num{flex:none;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--acc);border-bottom:4px solid var(--accd);color:#fff;font-weight:900;font-size:1.05rem}
.mod.done{background:var(--ok);border-color:var(--okd);color:#fff}.mod.done .mute{color:#e8ffd0}
.mod.done .num{background:#fff;color:var(--ok);border-color:#d7f5b8}
.staffwrap{overflow-x:auto}
svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;align-items:center}
button,select{font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:.82rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid var(--bd);border-bottom-width:4px;background:var(--card);color:var(--acc);cursor:pointer}
select{text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--fg)}
button:active{transform:translateY(2px);border-bottom-width:2px}
button.primary{background:var(--ok);border-color:var(--okd);color:#fff}
button.warm{background:var(--warm);border-color:var(--warmd);color:#fff}
button.sel{background:#ddf4ff;border-color:var(--acc);color:var(--accd)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){button.sel{background:#1b3a4a}}
button.ok{background:var(--ok);border-color:var(--okd);color:#fff}
button:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:default}
.seg{display:flex;gap:0}.seg button{border-radius:0}.seg button:first-child{border-radius:14px 0 0 14px}.seg button:last-child{border-radius:0 14px 14px 0}
label{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--mute);display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.big{font-size:2rem;font-weight:900;line-height:1}
.rect{background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--bd);border-bottom-width:4px;border-radius:16px;padding:10px 16px;font-size:1.45rem;font-weight:900;overflow-x:auto;white-space:nowrap;margin-bottom:14px}
.rect .ar{color:var(--mute);font-weight:600;margin:0 3px}
.meter{position:relative;height:54px;margin-top:8px}
.bar{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:20px;height:14px;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--bad),var(--ok) 38%,var(--ok) 62%,var(--bad));opacity:.45}
.zone{position:absolute;left:50%;top:14px;height:26px;width:3px;background:var(--fg);opacity:.5}
.needle{position:absolute;top:10px;width:8px;height:34px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--acc);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);transition:left .08s}
.scale{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.75rem;color:var(--mute)}
.hold{height:14px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bd);overflow:hidden;margin-top:10px}.hold i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--ok);border-radius:8px}
#msg{min-height:1.4em;margin-top:8px;font-weight:800}
table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:.88rem}td,th{padding:5px 6px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--bd);text-align:left}
.hide{display:none}.key{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--mute)}
.top{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}.top h2{margin:0}
.tabs button{flex:1}button.sm{font-size:.72rem;padding:7px 11px}
summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:800;color:var(--mute)}
.mas{flex:none}.mas svg{width:64px;height:64px;animation:bob 2.2s ease-in-out infinite}
.mas .mo{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;transition:transform .2s}
.mas.happy svg{animation:jump .5s ease-in-out infinite}.mas.happy .mo{transform:scaleY(3)}
.mas.sad svg{animation:shake .35s}.mas.sad .mo{transform:scaleX(.6)}
@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(-3deg)}}
@keyframes jump{50%{transform:translateY(-12px) scale(1.06)}}
@keyframes shake{25%{transform:translateX(-5px)}75%{transform:translateX(5px)}}
.fl{position:absolute;right:0;top:-6px;width:150px;height:70px;pointer-events:none}
.fl i{position:absolute;bottom:0;font-style:normal;font-size:1.6rem;color:var(--acc);opacity:0;animation:fl 5s linear infinite}
.fl i:nth-child(1){left:5%}.fl i:nth-child(2){left:30%;animation-delay:1.2s;color:var(--ok)}.fl i:nth-child(3){left:55%;animation-delay:2.4s;color:var(--warm)}.fl i:nth-child(4){left:80%;animation-delay:3.6s}
@keyframes fl{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(0)}15%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-60px) rotate(25deg)}}
.needle{width:24px;height:24px;top:15px;border-radius:50%;transition:left .12s cubic-bezier(.3,1.7,.5,1),background .2s}
.needle.in{background:var(--ok);animation:pulse .6s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(88,204,2,.6)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 16px rgba(88,204,2,0)}}
.hold i{transition:width .1s;background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(255,255,255,.25) 25%,transparent 25%,transparent 50%,rgba(255,255,255,.25) 50%,rgba(255,255,255,.25) 75%,transparent 75%);background-size:20px 20px;animation:st 1s linear infinite}
@keyframes st{to{background-position:20px 0}}
body{background:radial-gradient(900px 400px at 85% -10%,rgba(28,176,246,.14),transparent),radial-gradient(700px 400px at -10% 0,rgba(88,204,2,.14),transparent),var(--bg);background-attachment:fixed}
.hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6fdc12,#2fb344);color:#fff;border-radius:26px;padding:20px;display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 6px 0 #58a700;margin-bottom:16px}
.hero h1{color:#fff;font-size:2.1rem;margin:0}.hero .s2{color:#eaffd6;font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem}
.hero .mas svg{width:84px;height:84px}.hero .fl i{color:#fff}
.pbar{height:14px;border-radius:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.3);margin:10px 0 4px;overflow:hidden}.pbar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:#fff;border-radius:8px;transition:width .6s}
.card{box-shadow:0 3px 0 var(--bd)}.mod{box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--bd);transition:transform .12s}.mod:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.top{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2cbcff,#1899d6);color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:14px 16px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #1478a8}
.top h2{color:#fff}.top .mute{color:#d6f0ff}.top button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);color:#fff}
.bt{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%}.bt.tap{animation:tap .28s ease-out}
@keyframes tap{40%{transform:translateY(4px) rotate(var(--r)) scale(1.06,.94)}}
.bar{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--bad),var(--ok) 15%,var(--ok) 85%,var(--bad))}
.mas svg{width:54px;height:72px;overflow:visible}.hero .mas svg{width:72px;height:96px}
.mas .fr{display:none}.mas.sad .sm{display:none}.mas.sad .fr{display:inline}
.mas .sm{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 0;transition:transform .2s}.mas.happy .sm{transform:scale(1.15,1.2)}
.mas.sad svg{filter:saturate(.7)}
.nt{transform-box:fill-box;animation:nt 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes nt{50%{transform:translateY(-4px) rotate(8deg)}}
.num{position:relative;font-size:1.35rem}.nb{position:absolute;right:-5px;bottom:-5px;background:var(--card);color:var(--fg);border:2px solid var(--bd);border-radius:10px;font-size:.62rem;padding:0 5px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.3}
.needle{transition:left .25s ease-out,background .3s}.needle.in{animation:pulse 1.2s ease-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(88,204,2,.35)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 10px rgba(88,204,2,0)}}
.hold i{transition:width .3s ease-out;animation:none}
body{background:var(--bg)}main{position:relative}
:root{--wa:#eaf8d9;--wb:#e0f3ff;--wl:#d3e8f4}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--wa:#183024;--wb:#15303b;--wl:#254452}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--wa:#183024;--wb:#15303b;--wl:#254452}
.wall{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;pointer-events:none}.wall svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.mas svg{width:96px;height:128px;min-width:0}.hero .mas svg{width:120px;height:150px}
.rk{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid var(--bd);margin-bottom:8px}
.rk.me{border-color:var(--ok);background:rgba(88,204,2,.12)}.pos{width:34px;text-align:center;font-weight:900;font-size:1.1rem}
@media(max-width:600px){
main{padding:12px 10px 32px}
.hero{padding:14px;gap:10px;border-radius:20px}.hero h1{font-size:1.6rem}.hero .mas svg{width:78px;height:104px}
.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.fl{display:none}
.top{padding:10px 12px}.top h2{font-size:1.05rem}
button,select{padding:9px 12px;font-size:.76rem}
.tabs button{flex:1 1 30%}.seg{flex:1}.seg button{flex:1}
.mas svg{width:72px;height:96px}.big{font-size:1.6rem}.card{padding:12px}
.rect{font-size:1.15rem}.row label{font-size:.8rem}
}
/* ===== Beethoven · treino diário · calendário · lembrete ===== */
input[type=time]{font:inherit;font-weight:800;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid var(--bd);background:var(--card);color:var(--fg)}
.mas.talk .sm{animation:talk .2s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes talk{from{transform:scale(1,.55)}to{transform:scale(1.1,1.7)}}

/* botão flutuante */
.bee-fab{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:60;width:74px;height:74px;padding:0;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--okd);border-bottom-width:6px;background:#fff4d6;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.bee-fab .mas svg,.bee-h .mas svg{animation:none;min-width:0}
.bee-fab .mas svg{width:70px;height:60px;margin-top:6px}
.bee-fab.on{animation:bpulse 1s ease-out infinite}
.bee-dot{position:absolute;top:7px;right:9px;width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bad);border:2px solid #fff}
@keyframes bpulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,75,75,.55)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 16px rgba(255,75,75,0)}}

/* painel */
.bee{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:calc(98px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:61;width:min(390px,calc(100vw - 28px));max-height:min(580px,calc(100vh - 130px));display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--bd);border-bottom-width:5px;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 14px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.3);overflow:hidden}
.bee.hide,.mdl.hide,.toast.hide{display:none}
.bee-h{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 12px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2cbcff,#1899d6);color:#fff}
.bee-h .mas{flex:none;width:58px;height:58px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:50%;background:#fff4d6;border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);display:grid;place-items:center}
.bee-h .mas svg{width:56px;height:48px;margin-top:4px}
.bee-h .mute{color:#d6f0ff;font-size:.78rem}
.bee-h b{font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:900}
.bee-h>div{flex:1;min-width:0}
.bee-h button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35);color:#fff;padding:6px 10px}
.bee-log{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:12px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-height:150px}
.bm{max-width:90%;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:16px;font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.38;font-weight:700;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.bm.bot{align-self:flex-start;background:var(--bg);border:2px solid var(--bd);border-bottom-left-radius:4px}
.bm.me{align-self:flex-end;background:var(--acc);color:#fff;border-bottom-right-radius:4px}
.bm table{font-size:.8rem;margin-top:4px}
.bm .chips{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:6px 0 2px}
.bm .chips span{border:2px solid var(--bd);border-radius:12px;padding:3px 8px;font-size:.78rem}
.bm ul{margin:6px 0 0;padding-left:18px}
.bee-chips{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;padding:0 12px 8px;scrollbar-width:none}
.bee-chips::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.bee-chips button{flex:none;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;font-size:.76rem;padding:6px 11px;border-bottom-width:3px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap}
.bee-in{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:8px 12px 12px;border-top:2px solid var(--bd)}
.bee-in input{flex:1;min-width:0;font:inherit;font-weight:700;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid var(--bd);background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg)}
.bee-in button{padding:10px 12px}
#beeMic.on{background:var(--bad);border-color:#c23030;animation:bpulse 1s ease-out infinite}
@media (max-width:600px){.bee{right:8px;left:8px;width:auto;bottom:calc(96px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}}

/* cartão de treino diário */
.dt{font-size:2rem;font-weight:900;line-height:1.1;margin-top:2px}
.dbar{height:14px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--bd);overflow:hidden;margin:8px 0 6px}
.dbar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--warm);border-radius:8px;transition:width .6s}
.dbar.done i{background:var(--ok)}
.tmr{margin-left:auto;white-space:nowrap;flex:none}

/* modal, calendário */
.mdl{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:80;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:14px}
.mbox{position:relative;background:var(--card);border:2px solid var(--bd);border-radius:22px;padding:16px;width:min(470px,100%);max-height:92vh;overflow:auto}
.mbox h2{padding-right:44px}
.mx{position:absolute;right:12px;top:12px}
.cal-g{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);gap:5px}
.cal-w{text-align:center;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--mute);font-weight:800}
.cd{aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:12px;border:2px solid var(--bd);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.88rem;line-height:1.1;cursor:pointer}
.cd small{font-size:.64rem;color:var(--mute);font-weight:800}
.cd.part{background:rgba(255,150,0,.18);border-color:var(--warm)}
.cd.ok{background:var(--ok);border-color:var(--okd);color:#fff}
.cd.ok small{color:#eaffd6}
.cd.today{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--acc)}
.cd.sel{outline:3px solid var(--fg);outline-offset:1px}
.cd.fut{opacity:.45}
.cd.emp{border:0;cursor:default;visibility:hidden}
.cs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.cs div{flex:1 1 40%;border:2px solid var(--bd);border-radius:14px;padding:8px 10px}
.cs b{display:block;font-size:1.25rem}

/* aviso */
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;top:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top,0px));transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:90;background:var(--fg);color:var(--bg);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:14px;font-weight:800;max-width:min(92vw,430px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.3);cursor:pointer;text-align:center}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.mas.talk .sm,.bee-fab.on,#beeMic.on{animation:none}}
.mas.lip .sm{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
.pfi{font:inherit;font-weight:700;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:10px;border:2px solid var(--bd);background:var(--card);color:var(--fg);width:100%;margin:3px 0 8px}
.bscw{flex:0 0 46%;max-width:300px}.bscw svg{border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.25)}
.sc{display:none}.sc.on{display:inline}
.chw{transition:transform 1.4s linear}.sc.pre .chw{transform:translateX(-150px);transition:none}.sc.out .chw{transform:translateX(260px)}
.chb{transform-origin:48px 147px;transition:transform 1s ease}
.chr .fr{display:none}.chr.sad .sm{display:none}.chr.sad .fr{display:inline}.chr .zz{display:none}
.sc.walk .chb,.s2.act .chb{animation:wb .4s ease-in-out infinite}.sc.walk .f1,.s2.act .f1{animation:f1 .4s linear infinite}.sc.walk .f2,.s2.act .f2{animation:f2 .4s linear infinite}
@keyframes wb{50%{transform:translateY(-3px) rotate(2.5deg)}}@keyframes f1{0%,100%{transform:translate(-6px,0)}50%{transform:translate(6px,-3px)}}@keyframes f2{0%,100%{transform:translate(6px,-3px)}50%{transform:translate(-6px,0)}}
.front{opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}.sc.act .front{opacity:1}
.s1.act .chb,.s3.act .chb{animation:sway 1s ease-in-out infinite}.s3.act .chb{animation-duration:2.4s}
@keyframes sway{0%,100%{transform:translateY(10px) rotate(2.5deg)}50%{transform:translateY(10px) rotate(-3.5deg)}}
.s1.act .hd1{animation:key .3s ease-in-out infinite}.s1.act .hd2{animation:key .3s ease-in-out .15s infinite}@keyframes key{50%{transform:translateY(3px)}}
.nn,.zzz,.pn,.wt,.soak,.brr{opacity:0}.s1.act .nn{animation:fnote 2.4s linear infinite}@keyframes fnote{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(0)}20%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-34px) rotate(20deg)}}
.s2.on .scr{animation:scr 3s linear infinite}@keyframes scr{to{transform:translateX(-150px)}}
.s3.act .qu{animation:wr .5s ease-in-out infinite}@keyframes wr{50%{transform:translate(7px,-2px)}}.s3.act .pn{animation:pn .01s forwards}@keyframes pn{to{opacity:1}}
.fl2{animation:flk .3s infinite alternate;transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:50% 100%}@keyframes flk{to{transform:scaleY(.8)}}
.bk{transform-origin:168px 34px}.s4.act .bk{animation:tip 2.4s ease forwards}@keyframes tip{0%,25%{transform:rotate(0)}60%,100%{transform:rotate(-88deg)}}
.s4.act .wt{animation:wtr .7s linear 4 backwards}@keyframes wtr{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(0)}15%{opacity:.85}85%{opacity:.85}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(34px)}}
.s4 .arm{opacity:0}.s4.act .arm{opacity:1}.s4.act .soak{animation:soak 5s ease 2s forwards}@keyframes soak{0%{opacity:0}20%{opacity:.35}100%{opacity:0}}
.s4.shiv .chb{animation:shiv .1s linear infinite}@keyframes shiv{0%,100%{transform:translateX(-2px)}50%{transform:translateX(2px)}}.s4.shiv .brr{opacity:1}
.s5.act .chb{transform:translateY(-26px) rotate(-90deg)}.s5.act .zz{display:inline}.s5.act .zzz{animation:fnote 2.6s linear infinite}
.tw{animation:tw 1.6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}@keyframes tw{to{opacity:.3}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.sc *{animation-duration:0s!important}}
.hero h1{font-size:1.45rem;line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:.02em}
.mod .num.t{background:#1cb0f6;border-color:#1899d6}.mod .num.a{background:#a560e8;border-color:#7f3fc0}
.mod.lk .num.t,.mod.lk .num.a{background:#9aa5ab;border-color:#7d878c}
.mod.done .num.t,.mod.done .num.a{background:#fff;border-color:#d7f5b8}
.num svg{width:24px;height:24px;display:block}
.hero div[style*="flex:1"]{text-align:center}.hero h1{text-align:center}
#bday{background:none;border:0;box-shadow:none;padding:2px 4px;margin-bottom:8px}#bday .mute{font-size:.74rem}#bday .bdl div{padding:1px 0;border:0;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600}
#bdm{background:none;border:0;padding:2px 0;font-size:.72rem;text-transform:none;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--mute);text-decoration:underline}
.bdl div{padding:6px 0;border-bottom:2px solid var(--bd)}.bdl div:last-child{border:0}

/* ===== v12: afinador cartum, rosto, Pozzoli ===== */
.gauge{max-width:380px;margin:8px auto 2px}.gauge svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;overflow:visible}
#needle{transform-origin:150px 156px;transform-box:view-box;transition:transform .12s cubic-bezier(.3,1.7,.5,1)}
.gauge .mo2,.gauge .spk{display:none}.gauge.in .mo2{display:block}.gauge.in .mo1{display:none}.gauge.in .hub{fill:#c8f08f}
.gauge.in .spk{display:block}.gauge .spk polygon{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center;animation:spk .7s ease-in-out infinite alternate}.gauge .spk polygon:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.2s}.gauge .spk polygon:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.4s}
@keyframes spk{from{transform:scale(.7) rotate(-10deg)}to{transform:scale(1.2) rotate(12deg)}}
.hold{margin-top:6px}
.card .mas.face svg{width:112px;height:114px;overflow:hidden;min-width:0;filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.12))}
@media(max-width:600px){.card .mas.face svg{width:92px;height:94px}}
.holmsg{font-weight:900;color:#fff}
.hmenu{margin:6px 0 12px;display:flex;width:100%}.hmenu button{flex:1;font-size:.78rem}
.pzimg{background:#fff;border-radius:12px;border:2px solid var(--bd);overflow-x:auto;padding:4px}.pzimg img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-width:none}.pzimg.zoom img{width:190%}
.pzdots{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center}.pzd{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;font-weight:900;color:var(--mute)}.pzd i{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bd);transition:transform .08s,background .08s}.pzd.on i{background:var(--ok);transform:scale(1.25)}.pzd:first-child.on i{background:var(--warm)}
#pz .top,#pz>.card{margin-bottom:10px}

button.holding{background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.55),rgba(255,255,255,.55));background-repeat:no-repeat;background-size:0 100%;animation:holdfill var(--hold,1.5s) linear forwards}
@keyframes holdfill{to{background-size:100% 100%}}
#mdl button{-webkit-touch-callout:none;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;touch-action:manipulation}
#gpo::after{content:" · segure 1,5 s";font-weight:700;font-size:.72em;opacity:.9}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wall" aria-hidden="true"><svg viewBox="0 0 1440 900" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"><circle cx="1280" cy="90" r="280" fill="var(--wa)"/><circle cx="90" cy="800" r="320" fill="var(--wb)"/><g fill="none" stroke="var(--wl)" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M-40 620C260 540 520 700 820 620S1300 540 1500 600"/><path d="M-40 631C260 551 520 711 820 631S1300 551 1500 611"/><path d="M-40 642C260 562 520 722 820 642S1300 562 1500 622"/><path d="M-40 653C260 573 520 733 820 653S1300 573 1500 633"/><path d="M-40 664C260 584 520 744 820 664S1300 584 1500 644"/></g><g fill="var(--wl)" font-size="54"><text x="300" y="560">♪</text><text x="640" y="720">♫</text><text x="1010" y="560">♩</text><text x="1180" y="690">♬</text></g></svg></div>
<main>
<div id="home">
  <div class="hero"><div class="bscw"><svg id="bsc" viewBox="0 0 300 160" role="img" aria-label="Beethoven"></svg></div><div class="mas happy hide" id="hmas"></div><div style="flex:1"><h1>SOLFEJO TONAL E ATONAL</h1><div class="s2">método Bohumil Med</div><div class="s2 holmsg" id="holmsg"></div><div class="pbar"><i id="hp"></i></div><div class="s2" id="hpt"></div></div><div class="fl" aria-hidden="true"><i>♪</i><i>♫</i><i>♩</i><i>♬</i></div></div>
  <div class="card" id="daily">
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start">
      <div style="flex:1;min-width:0"><b>Treino de hoje</b>
        <div class="dt"><span id="dtime">0:00</span> <span class="mute" style="font-size:1rem">/ 10:00</span></div>
        <div class="dbar" id="dbarw"><i id="dfill"></i></div>
        <div class="mute" id="dsub"></div></div>
      <button class="sm" id="dpause">⏸ Pausar</button>
    </div>
    <div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><button id="pfb">👤 Perfil</button><button id="t10">⏲ Timer 10 min</button><button id="mus">🎵 Música</button><button id="dcal">📅 Calendário</button><button id="drem">🔔 Lembrete diário</button><button class="primary" id="dbee">🎤 Falar com o Beethoven</button></div>
  </div>
  
<div class="card" id="bday"><span class="mute">🎂 Aniversariantes do mês · 3 compositores</span><div class="bdl" id="bdl" style="margin:2px 0 4px"></div><button id="bdm">Dias importantes da música ›</button></div>
  <div class="row" style="margin:10px 0 14px"><button class="primary" id="mic">Ativar microfone</button><button id="rkbtn">🏆 Ranking</button><span class="mute" id="micst">Ative o microfone antes de começar.</span>
  <label><input type="checkbox" id="free"> Destravar todas as lições</label></div>
  <div class="seg hmenu" id="hmenu"><button data-h="sol" class="sel">🎵 Solfejo Bohumil Med</button><button data-h="pz">🥁 POZZOLI RÍTMICO</button></div>
  <div class="card hide" id="pzinfo"><b>Pozzoli · Guia teórico‑prático para o ensino do ditado musical</b><div class="mute">Todas as séries de exercícios de ditado rítmico do livro (17 séries, compassos simples e compostos) mais os exercícios complementares. Abra uma série, estude as páginas com o metrônomo e marque como estudada.</div></div>
  <div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
  <div class="grid hide" id="pzgrid"></div>
</div>

<div id="rank" class="hide"><div class="top"><button id="rkback" aria-label="Voltar">←</button><div><h2>🏆 Ranking</h2><div class="mute">Cada nota certa vale 1 ponto (2 no modo Ritmo)</div></div></div><div class="card" id="rklist"></div></div>
<div id="pz" class="hide"><div class="top"><button id="pzback" aria-label="Voltar">←</button><div><h2 id="pzt"></h2><div class="mute" id="pzs"></div></div></div>
  <div class="card"><div class="row" id="pzpg" style="margin-bottom:8px"></div><div class="pzimg" id="pzimg"></div>
   <div class="row" style="margin-top:8px"><button class="sm" id="pzprev">‹ Anterior</button><button class="sm" id="pznext">Próxima ›</button><button class="sm" id="pzzoom">🔍 Ampliar</button></div></div>
  <div class="card"><b>Metrônomo do ditado</b><div class="mute">1 = tempo forte (f) · os demais = tempos fracos (d). Nos compostos, os cliques menores marcam a subdivisão ternária.</div>
   <div class="row" style="margin:8px 0"><label>Compasso <select id="pzmt"></select></label><label>♩ <input type="range" id="pzbpm" min="40" max="140" value="60"><span id="pzbv">60</span></label><button class="primary" id="pzplay">▶ Metrônomo</button></div><div class="pzdots" id="pzdots"></div></div>
  <div class="card"><button id="pzdone">✓ Marcar série como estudada</button></div></div>
<div id="mod" class="hide">

const CL={treble:{g:'𝄞',bot:30,gy:104,fs:76,gx:14,sh:0},bass:{g:'𝄢',bot:18,gy:82,fs:60,gx:16,sh:-14},alto:{g:'𝄡',bot:24,gy:88,fs:62,gx:16,sh:-7}};

/* ---------- Estado ---------- */
let mi=0,mode='ex',items=[],bars=[],cur=0,status=[],rec=[],holdStart=0,scName='Maior',clef='treble',wuIdx=0,curKey=0,curStr='',bi=-1,bat=null,noteStart=0,off=0,offSum=0,offCnt=0;
let ctx=null,analyser=null,buf=null,running=false,loopOn=false,muteUntil=0,micGain=null,lastSeen=0,hl=-1,playing=false,timers=[];
let TOL=35;const HOLD=450,PASS=0.95;let XP=0,DB=null,UID=null,UP=null,rkUnsub=null,lastH=0,mg=null,lastBi=0,rt=null,rm='free';const BEATS={4:1,2:2,1:4};
let prog={};try{prog=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('solfejo-med2')||'{}')}catch(e){}
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('solfejo-med2',JSON.stringify(prog))}catch(e){}};
function pmi(i){const P=prog[i]||(prog[i]={});P.ex=P.ex||0;P.wu=P.wu||0;P.bk=P.bk||{};P.keys=P.keys||{};P.st=P.st||{d:{},p:{}};return P}
const pm=()=>pmi(mi);
const passed=j=>{const P=prog[j];return !!(P&&P.bk&&BKS(j).every((_,k)=>P.bk[k]>=PASS))};
const locked=i=>!$('free').checked&&MODS.slice(0,i).some((m,j)=>m.book===1&&!passed(j));

/* ---------- Notas, tonalidade e grafia ---------- */
const f2m=m=>440*Math.pow(2,(m-69)/12);
const K=()=>KEYS[curKey];
function parse(tok){const m=/^([1-7])([\^_]?)([#b]?)(!?)(?::([124]))?$/.exec(tok);return{d:+m[1],oct:m[2]==='^'?1:m[2]==='_'?-1:0,acc:m[3]==='#'?1:m[3]==='b'?-1:0,bang:!!m[4],du:m[5]?+m[5]:4}}
const semis=it=>SC[scName][it.d-1]+it.acc;
const tonicMidi=()=>K()[3]+(clef==='bass'?-12:0);
const midi=it=>tonicMidi()+12*it.oct+semis(it);
const tIdx=()=>{const k=K();return (Math.floor((tonicMidi()-k[2])/12)-1)*7+k[1]};
const idxOf=it=>tIdx()+it.d-1+7*it.oct;
const natM=i=>12*(Math.floor(i/7)+1)+NAT[((i%7)+7)%7];
const need=it=>midi(it)-natM(idxOf(it));
const absStep=it=>it.oct*7+it.d;
const label=it=>{const a=semis(it)-MAJ[it.d-1];return it.d+(a>0?'♯':a<0?'♭':'')};
const nameOf=it=>{const n=need(it);return NOMES[((idxOf(it)%7)+7)%7]+(n>0?'♯':n<0?'♭':'')};
function ksig(){const k=K(),ts=NAT[k[1]]+k[2],a=Array(7).fill(0);
  for(let j=0;j<7;j++){const L=(k[1]+j)%7;let x=(((ts+MAJ[j]-NAT[L])%12)+12)%12;if(x>6)x-=12;a[L]=x}return a}
const JI=[1,16/15,9/8,6/5,5/4,4/3,45/32,3/2,8/5,5/3,9/5,15/8];
function targetFreq(it){
  if($('temp').value==='t')return f2m(midi(it));
  const s=semis(it),o=Math.floor(s/12);
  return f2m(tonicMidi())*JI[((s%12)+12)%12]*Math.pow(2,o+it.oct);
}
function toks2items(str){const its=[],bs=[];str.trim().split(/\s+/).forEach(x=>{if(x==='|')bs.push(its.length);else its.push(parse(x))});return{its,bs}}
const tk=s=>{const d=((s%7)+7)%7+1,o=Math.floor(s/7);return d+(o>0?'^':o<0?'_':'')};

/* ---------- Geração de exercícios ---------- */
function allowedSteps(M){const al=[];for(let s=-1;s<=7;s++)if(M.deg.includes(((s%7)+7)%7+1))al.push(s);return al}
function gen(M){
  const al=allowedSteps(M);let seq=[0],c=0;
  for(let i=1;i<7;i++){
    let cand=al.filter(s=>s!==c&&M.leaps.includes(Math.abs(s-c)));
    if(!cand.length)cand=al.filter(s=>s!==c&&Math.abs(s-c)<=2);
    c=cand[Math.floor(Math.random()*cand.length)];seq.push(c);
  }
  if(c!==0)seq.push(0);
  const t=seq.map(tk);
  if(M.chrom){const k=2+Math.floor(Math.random()*(t.length-3));t[k]=M.chrom[Math.floor(Math.random()*M.chrom.length)]}
  return t.join(' ');
}
function genRev(M){
  const P=pm(),D=P.st.d,Pp=P.st.p,al=allowedSteps(M);
  const lab=s=>label(parse(tk(s))),rt=x=>x?(x.e+1)/(x.n+2):.3;
  let c=0,seq=[0];
  for(let i=1;i<11;i++){
    const cand=al.filter(s=>s!==c);
    const w=cand.map(s=>(1+9*rt(D[lab(s)]))*(1+6*rt(Pp[lab(c)+(s>c?'↗':'↘')+lab(s)])));
    let r=Math.random()*w.reduce((a,x)=>a+x,0),k=0;while((r-=w[k])>0&&k<cand.length-1)k++;
    c=cand[k];seq.push(c);
  }
  if(c!==0)seq.push(0);
  const top=Object.entries(D).filter(([l,x])=>x.n>=2).sort((a,b)=>rt(b[1])-rt(a[1])).slice(0,3).map(e=>e[0]);
  return{s:seq.map(tk).join(' '),top};
}

/* ---------- Partitura ---------- */
const CLEFG=oy=>`<g transform="translate(0,${oy})"><path d="M19 110C19 118 30 118 30 108L35 40C36 28 41 21 43 28C45 35 38 46 33 58C27 68 17 76 17 87C17 99 27 103 36 100C45 96 46 83 38 77C31 72 23 76 23 84C23 90 29 92 33 88" fill="none" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="19" cy="110" r="3.5" fill="var(--line)"/></g>`;
const LEGEND=W=>{const R=[['terça maior ascendente','DÓ – MI','↗','var(--ok)'],['terça maior descendente','MI – DÓ','↘','var(--ok)'],['terça menor ascendente','MI – SOL','↗','var(--acc)'],['terça menor descendente','SOL – MI','↘','var(--acc)']],fs=Math.max(11,Math.min(14,W/32));
  let g=`<rect x="10" y="6" width="${W-20}" height="82" rx="12" fill="var(--card)" stroke="var(--bd)" stroke-width="2"/>`;
  R.forEach((r,i)=>{g+=`<text x="26" y="${28+i*19}" font-size="${fs}" font-weight="800" fill="var(--fg)"><tspan fill="${r[3]}" font-size="${fs+3}">${r[2]}</tspan> ${r[0]} = <tspan font-weight="900" fill="${r[3]}">${r[1]}</tspan></text>`});return g};
let XS=[],WS=[],OY=[];
function draw(){
  const C=CL[clef],ks=ksig(),nks=ks.filter(x=>x).length,ord=ks.some(x=>x>0)?SHP:FLT,n=items.length,svg=$('staff'),LG=mi===1?92:0;
  const LW=Math.max(420,Math.min(mi===1?1100:900,($('sw').clientWidth||760)*(mi===1?1.4:1.15))),X0=70+nks*10+26,AV=LW-X0-24,SYS=mi===1?162:175;
  const wt=i=>34*(items[i].du===4?1:items[i].du===2?1.5:(mode==='book'&&MODS[mi].book===2?1.2:2)),per=bars.length?999:4,segs=[];
  const bs=[0,...bars,n].filter((v,i,a)=>i===0||v!==a[i-1]);
  for(let m=0;m<bs.length-1;m++)for(let a=bs[m];a<bs[m+1];a+=per)segs.push([a,Math.min(bs[m+1],a+per)]);
  const sw=g=>{let w=14;for(let i=g[0];i<g[1];i++)w+=wt(i);return w},sys=[];let c=null;
  segs.forEach(g=>{const w=sw(g);if(!c||c.w+w>AV){c={g:[g],w};sys.push(c)}else{c.g.push(g);c.w+=w}});
  XS=[];WS=[];OY=[];let h=LG?LEGEND(LW):'';
  sys.forEach((S,r)=>{
    const oy=r*SYS+LG,y=i=>oy+98-(i-C.bot)*6,last=r===sys.length-1,k=Math.min(last&&sys.length>1?1:1.35,AV/S.w),XE=last?Math.min(LW-12,X0+S.w*k+6):LW-12;
    for(let i=0;i<5;i++)h+=`<line x1="10" x2="${XE+2}" y1="${oy+50+i*12}" y2="${oy+50+i*12}" stroke="var(--line)"/>`;
    h+=`<line x1="10" x2="10" y1="${oy+50}" y2="${oy+98}" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="1.5"/><line x1="${XE}" x2="${XE}" y1="${oy+50}" y2="${oy+98}" stroke="var(--line)" stroke-width="${last?4:1.5}"/>`;
    h+=clef==='treble'?CLEFG(oy):`<text x="${C.gx}" y="${oy+C.gy}" font-size="${C.fs}" fill="var(--line)" font-family="'Noto Music','Segoe UI Symbol','Apple Symbols',serif">${C.g}</text>`;
    for(let q=0;q<nks;q++)h+=`<text x="${64+q*10}" y="${y(ord[q]+C.sh)+7}" font-size="20" fill="var(--line)">${ord===SHP?'♯':'♭'}</text>`;
    let x=X0;S.g.forEach((g,si)=>{
      if(si>0&&bars.includes(g[0]))h+=`<line x1="${x}" x2="${x}" y1="${oy+50}" y2="${oy+98}" stroke="var(--line)"/>`;
      x+=7*k;for(let i=g[0];i<g[1];i++){const w=wt(i)*k;XS[i]=x+w/2;WS[i]=w;OY[i]=oy;x+=w}x+=7*k});
  });
  items.forEach((it,i)=>{
    const x=XS[i],W=WS[i],oy=OY[i],idx=idxOf(it),y=j=>oy+98-(j-C.bot)*6,yy=y(idx);
    const col=status[i]==='ok'?'var(--ok)':status[i]==='bad'?'var(--bad)':(i===cur?'var(--acc)':'var(--line)');
    for(let k=C.bot-2;k>=idx;k-=2)h+=`<line x1="${x-14}" x2="${x+14}" y1="${y(k)}" y2="${y(k)}" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="1.4"/>`;
    for(let k=C.bot+10;k<=idx;k+=2)h+=`<line x1="${x-14}" x2="${x+14}" y1="${y(k)}" y2="${y(k)}" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="1.4"/>`;
    if(i===hl)h+=`<rect x="${x-W/2+2}" y="${oy+28}" width="${W-4}" height="104" rx="10" fill="#ff9600" opacity=".25"/>`;
    if(i===cur&&status[i]!=='ok'){h+=`<rect x="${x-W/2+2}" y="${oy+28}" width="${W-4}" height="104" rx="10" fill="var(--acc)" opacity=".1"/>`;if(rt)h+=`<rect id="ph" x="${x-W/2+2}" y="${oy+28}" width="0" height="104" rx="10" fill="var(--acc)" opacity=".3"/>`}
    const nd=need(it),ABS=mode==='book'&&MODS[mi].book===2;if(ABS?it.bang:nd!==ks[((idx%7)+7)%7])h+=`<text x="${x-22}" y="${yy+6}" font-size="18" fill="${col}">${nd>0?'♯':nd<0?'♭':'♮'}</text>`;
    h+=`<ellipse cx="${x}" cy="${yy}" rx="8.5" ry="6.2" fill="${it.du===4?col:'none'}" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="1.8" transform="rotate(-20 ${x} ${yy})"/>`;
    if(it.du!==1)h+= idx<C.bot+4?`<line x1="${x+8}" x2="${x+8}" y1="${yy}" y2="${yy-34}" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="1.6"/>`:`<line x1="${x-8}" x2="${x-8}" y1="${yy}" y2="${yy+34}" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="1.6"/>`;
    const lc=status[i]==='ok'?'var(--ok)':(rec[i]&&rec[i].e?'var(--bad)':'var(--mute)');
    if($('shownum').checked&&mi!==1)h+=`<text x="${x}" y="${oy+150}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" font-weight="800" fill="${lc}">${label(it)}</text>`;
    if($('shownames').checked&&mi!==1)h+=`<text x="${x}" y="${oy+165}" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" fill="${lc}">${nameOf(it)}</text>`;
  });
  if(mi===1)for(let i=0;i<n-1;i++){const d=midi(items[i+1])-midi(items[i]),a=Math.abs(d);if(a!==3&&a!==4)continue;
    const up=d>0,mj=a===4,t=mj?(up?'DO–MI':'MI–DO'):(up?'MI–SOL':'SOL–MI'),col=mj?'var(--ok)':'var(--acc)',y0=OY[i]+144,cross=OY[i]!==OY[i+1],x1=XS[i]+4,x2=cross?Math.min(LW-14,x1+46):XS[i+1]-4,xm=(x1+x2)/2;
    h+=`<path d="M${x1} ${y0-9}V${y0-5}H${x2}${cross?'':`V${y0-9}`}" fill="none" stroke="${col}" stroke-width="1.5" opacity=".75"/><text x="${cross?x1:xm}" y="${y0+9}" text-anchor="${cross?'start':'middle'}" font-size="12.5" font-weight="900" fill="${col}">${up?'↗':'↘'} ${t}${cross?' ›':''}</text>`}
  svg.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${LW} ${sys.length*SYS+6+LG}`);svg.style.minWidth='';svg.innerHTML=h;
  $('target').textContent=cur<n?label(items[cur])+' · '+nameOf(items[cur]):'✓';
  updScore();
}
function updScore(){
  const e=rec.filter(r=>r.e).length,mx=Math.floor(items.length*(1-PASS));
  $('score').textContent=items.length?`Erros: ${e} (máx. ${mx} p/ 95%)`:'';
}
function drawRect(str){
  let h='',prev=null;
  str.trim().split(/\s+/).forEach(x=>{
    if(x==='|'){h+='<span class="ar">|</span>';return}
    const it=parse(x);
    if(prev){const a=absStep(it)-absStep(prev);h+=`<span class="ar">${a>0?'↗':a<0?'↘':'→'}</span>`}
    h+=`<span>${it.d}</span>`;prev=it;
  });
  $('rect').innerHTML=h;
}

/* ---------- Módulos ---------- */
const INT=new Set([1,3,5,7,9,13,15,17,19,23,28]),GRA=new Set([0,2,4,6,8]);
const IA='<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">';
const IC={t:IA+'<path d="M3 20h5v-5h5v-5h5V5h3"/></svg>',a:IA+'<path d="M12 4v16M8 8l4-4 4 4M8 16l4 4 4-4"/></svg>',l:IA+'<rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="9" rx="2"/><path d="M8 11V8a4 4 0 018 0v3"/></svg>'};
const KIND=i=>INT.has(i)?['a','Solfejo atonal · intervalos']:['t','Solfejo tonal · graus de escala'];
const done=i=>MODS[i].book?passed(i):!!(prog[i]&&prog[i].best>=PASS);
function home(){
  const nd=MODS.filter((_,i)=>done(i)).length;$('hp').style.width=(nd/MODS.length*100)+'%';$('hpt').textContent=nd+' de '+MODS.length+' lições concluídas · '+XP+' XP';
  $('grid').innerHTML=MODS.map((m,i)=>{const p=prog[i]||{},lk=locked(i),dn=done(i);
    return `<button class="mod${lk?' lk':''}${dn?' done':''}" data-i="${i}"><span class="num ${KIND(i)[0]}">${lk?IC.l:dn?'✓':IC[KIND(i)[0]]}<small class="nb">${i+1}</small></span><span><b>${m.t}</b><span class="mute">${KIND(i)[1]} · Livro, p. ${m.p}${m.wu?' · aquecimento':''}${m.book===1&&!dn?' · 95% p/ avançar':m.book===2&&!dn?' · 6 exercícios do livro':''}${p.ex>0?' · '+p.ex+' ex.':''}</span></span></button>`}).join('');
  document.querySelectorAll('.mod').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const i=+b.dataset.i;
    if(locked(i)){$('micst').textContent='Bloqueado: tire 95% em todos os 10 exercícios do módulo 1 (ou ative o modo livre).';return}openMod(i)});
}
function openMod(i){
  mi=i;const M=MODS[i];bi=-1;bat=null;
  $('home').classList.add('hide');$('mod').classList.remove('hide');
  $('modt').textContent=(i+1)+'. '+M.t;$('modp').textContent='Livro, p. '+M.p;
  $('wu').classList.toggle('hide',!M.wu);$('wupiano').classList.toggle('hide',!M.wu);
  $('bkwrap').classList.toggle('hide',!M.book);$('stats').classList.add('hide');
  $('key').innerHTML=(M.book?'<option value="-1">Original do livro</option>':'')+(M.book===2?'':KEYS.map((k,j)=>`<option value="${j}">${k[0]} maior</option>`).join(''));
  $('key').value=M.book?-1:0;
  $('wuvars').innerHTML='';
  if(M.wu&&M.wu.length>1)M.wu.forEach((w,k)=>{const b=document.createElement('button');b.textContent=w[0];b.dataset.k=k;b.onclick=()=>startWarm(k);$('wuvars').appendChild(b)});
  renderBook();window.scrollTo(0,0);
  M.book?startBook(0):M.wu?startWarm(0):startEx();
}
function setup(str,m){
  if(playing)stopSeq();
  const v=+$('key').value;curKey=v<0?BKS()[bi>=0?bi:lastBi][1]:v;
  rt=null;stopMetro();$('go').textContent='▶ Começar';curStr=str;const r=toks2items(str);items=r.its;bars=r.bs;cur=0;status=items.map(()=> 'p');rec=items.map(()=>({e:0,s:0,c:0}));
  holdStart=0;noteStart=performance.now();off=0;mode=m;$('hold').style.width='0';$('res').classList.add('hide');
  draw();setMsg(rm==='rhythm'?'Modo ritmo: toque em Começar (4 tempos de contagem).':running?'Cante a primeira nota.':'Ative o microfone na tela de módulos.');
}
function startWarm(k){
  const M=MODS[mi];wuIdx=k;bi=-1;scName='Maior';clef='treble';
  $('rectwrap').classList.remove('hide');drawRect(M.wu[k][1]);
  document.querySelectorAll('#wuvars button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('sel',+b.dataset.k===k));
  setup(M.wu[k][1],'warm');
  $('info').textContent='Aquecimento ('+M.wu[k][0]+') na tonalidade de '+K()[0]+' maior — ↗ sobe, ↘ desce; 1^ é a tônica aguda, 5_ a dominante grave.';
}
function startEx(){
  const M=MODS[mi];bi=-1;$('rectwrap').classList.add('hide');
  scName=M.sc?M.sc[Math.floor(Math.random()*M.sc.length)]:'Maior';clef=M.clef||'treble';
  setup(gen(M),'ex');
  $('info').textContent='Exercício gerado com os graus do capítulo · tônica '+nameOf({d:1,oct:0,acc:0,du:4})+(scName!=='Maior'?' · escala '+scName:'')+'.';
}
function startBook(i){
  bi=i;lastBi=i;scName='Maior';clef='treble';$('rectwrap').classList.add('hide');
  setup(BKS()[i][0],'book');
  $('info').textContent='Exercício '+(i+1)+' do livro · tonalidade de '+K()[0]+' maior'+(bat?' · bateria completa ('+(i+1)+'/'+BKS().length+')':'')+'.';
  renderBook();
}
function renderBook(){
  if(!MODS[mi].book)return;const P=pm();
  $('bk').innerHTML=BKS().map((_,k)=>{const b=P.bk[k];return `<button data-k="${k}" class="${b>=PASS?'ok':''}${bi===k?' sel':''}">Ex ${k+1}${b!=null?' · '+Math.round(b*100)+'%':''}${b>=PASS?' ✓':''}</button>`}).join('');
  document.querySelectorAll('#bk button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{bat=null;startBook(+b.dataset.k)});
  const done=Object.entries(P.keys).filter(e=>e[1]>=PASS).map(e=>e[0]);
  $('keysdone').textContent=MODS[mi].book===2?'Aprove os '+BKS().length+' exercícios com 95% para concluir o módulo.':'Tonalidades com os 10 exercícios aprovados: '+(done.length?done.join(', '):'nenhuma ainda')+'.';
}
function setMsg(t,c){$('mas').className='mas face'+(c==='var(--ok)'?' happy':c==='var(--bad)'?' sad':'');const m=$('msg');m.textContent=t;m.style.color=c||'var(--mute)'}

/* ---------- Estatísticas ---------- */
function record(i){
  const it=items[i],P=pm(),r=rec[i],lab=label(it);
  const d=P.st.d[lab]||(P.st.d[lab]={n:0,e:0,s:0,c:0});d.n++;if(r.e){d.e++;d.s+=r.s;d.c+=r.c}
  if(i>0){const pv=items[i-1],pl=label(pv)+(absStep(it)>absStep(pv)?'↗':'↘')+lab;
    const p=P.st.p[pl]||(P.st.p[pl]={n:0,e:0,s:0,c:0});p.n++;if(r.e)p.e++}
}
function renderStats(){
  const P=pm(),D=P.st.d,rows=Object.entries(D).sort((a,b)=>a[0].localeCompare(b[0]));
  if(!rows.length){$('stats').innerHTML='<b>Estatísticas</b><p class="mute">Ainda sem dados: cante alguns exercícios.</p>';return}
  let h='<b>Estatísticas deste módulo</b><table><tr><th>Grau</th><th>Notas</th><th>Acerto</th><th>Tendência</th></tr>';
  rows.forEach(([l,x])=>{const p=(x.n-x.e)/x.n,bad=x.n>=3&&p<PASS,av=x.c?x.s/x.c:0;
    h+=`<tr><td><b>${l}</b></td><td>${x.n}</td><td style="color:var(--${bad?'bad':'ok'})">${Math.round(p*100)}%${bad?' · melhorar':''}</td><td>${x.c>=2?(av>0?'agudo':'grave')+' ('+Math.abs(Math.round(av))+' ¢)':'—'}</td></tr>`});
  h+='</table>';
  const ps=Object.entries(P.st.p).filter(([l,x])=>x.n>=2&&x.e>0).sort((a,b)=>b[1].e/b[1].n-a[1].e/a[1].n).slice(0,4);
  if(ps.length)h+='<p class="mute" style="margin:10px 0 0">Passagens difíceis: '+ps.map(([l,x])=>`${l} (${x.e} erro${x.e>1?'s':''} em ${x.n})`).join(' · ')+'</p>';
  h+='<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px"><button id="rst">Zerar estatísticas</button></div>';
  $('stats').innerHTML=h;
  $('rst').onclick=()=>{P.st={d:{},p:{}};save();renderStats()};
}

/* ---------- Resultado ---------- */
function finish(){
  const ok=rec.filter(r=>!r.e).length,pct=ok/items.length,P=pm();
  if(mode==='ex')P.ex++;else if(mode==='warm')P.wu++;if(mode!=='book')P.best=Math.max(P.best||0,pct);
  let extra='';XP+=ok*(rm==='rhythm'?2:1);try{localStorage.setItem('solfejo-xp',XP)}catch(e){}pushRank();
  const buttons=[['again','Repetir']];
  if(mode==='book'){
    P.bk[bi]=Math.max(P.bk[bi]||0,pct);if(bat)bat.res[bi]=pct;
    if(bi<BKS().length-1)buttons.push(['next',bat?'Próximo exercício':'Próximo exercício do livro']);
    if(bat&&bi===BKS().length-1){
      const kn=bat.key<0?'Original':KEYS[bat.key][0],mn=Math.min(...bat.res);
      P.keys[kn]=Math.max(P.keys[kn]||0,mn);
      extra='<br>Bateria ('+kn+'): '+bat.res.map((x,k)=>`Ex${k+1} ${Math.round(x*100)}%`).join(' · ')+(mn>=PASS?'<br><b style="color:var(--ok)">Tonalidade aprovada!</b>':'<br><span style="color:var(--bad)">Repita os exercícios abaixo de 95%.</span>');
      if(passed(mi))extra+='<br><b style="color:var(--ok)">Módulo '+(mi+1)+' aprovado!'+(MODS[mi].book===1?' Próxima lição liberada.':'')+'</b>';
    }
  }else buttons.push(mode==='warm'?['go','Ir ao exercício']:['new','Novo exercício']);
  save();renderBook();renderStats();fanfare(pct>=PASS||mode!=='book');
  let h=`<b>${Math.round(pct*100)}% de acerto</b> · ${ok}/${items.length} notas`;
  if(mode==='book')h+=pct>=PASS?' · <span style="color:var(--ok)">✓ aprovado</span>':' · <span style="color:var(--bad)">abaixo de 95%</span>';
  $('res').innerHTML=h+extra+'<div class="row" style="margin-top:10px">'+buttons.map(b=>`<button class="${b[0]==='next'?'primary':''}" data-a="${b[0]}">${b[1]}</button>`).join('')+'</div>';
  $('res').classList.remove('hide');setMsg('Exercício completo!','var(--ok)');
}
$('res').onclick=e=>{const a=e.target.dataset&&e.target.dataset.a;if(!a)return;
  if(a==='again')setup(curStr,mode);
  else if(a==='next')startBook(bi+1);
  else if(a==='go'){MODS[mi].book?startBook(lastBi):startEx()}
  else if(a==='new'||a==='rev')startEx()};

/* ---------- Detecção de altura ---------- */
let nf=0,lastF=0,stab=0;
function detect(b,sr){const f=detect0(b,sr);if(f<0){stab=0;lastF=0;return -1}if(lastF&&Math.abs(1200*Math.log2(f/lastF))<70)stab++;else stab=0;lastF=f;return stab>=2?f:-1}
function detect0(b,sr){
  let e=0;for(let i=0;i<b.length;i++)e+=b[i]*b[i];
  const rms=Math.sqrt(e/b.length),cap=0.003;if(!nf)nf=Math.min(rms,cap);else if(rms<nf*1.5)nf=nf*.95+rms*.05;else nf=Math.min(cap,nf*1.0005);if(rms<Math.max(0.004,nf*2.8))return -1;
  const minL=Math.floor(sr/1000),maxL=Math.min(Math.floor(sr/70),b.length>>1);
  const W=b.length-maxL,r=new Float32Array(maxL+2);
  let e0=0;for(let i=0;i<W;i++)e0+=b[i]*b[i];
  let best=0;
  for(let l=minL;l<=maxL;l++){let c=0,el=0;for(let i=0;i<W;i++){c+=b[i]*b[i+l];el+=b[i+l]*b[i+l]}
    r[l]=c/Math.sqrt(e0*el+1e-9);if(r[l]>best)best=r[l]}
  if(best<0.7)return -1;
  for(let l=minL+1;l<maxL;l++){
    if(r[l]>=best*0.93&&r[l]>=r[l-1]&&r[l]>=r[l+1]){const a=r[l-1],bb=r[l],c=r[l+1],d=a-2*bb+c;return sr/(l+(d?0.5*(a-c)/d:0))}
  }
  return -1;
}
const CHROMA=['Dó','Dó♯','Ré','Ré♯','Mi','Fá','Fá♯','Sol','Sol♯','Lá','Lá♯','Si'];
function loop(){
  if(!running||$('mod').classList.contains('hide')){loopOn=false;return}
  analyser.getFloatTimeDomainData(buf);
  const now=performance.now(),f=now<muteUntil?-1:detect(buf,ctx.sampleRate),needle=$('needle');
  if(rt||rm==='rhythm'){rhythmTick(now,f);requestAnimationFrame(loop);return}
  if(f>0&&cur<items.length){
    lastSeen=now;
    const m=69+12*Math.log2(f/440);
    $('heard').textContent=CHROMA[((Math.round(m)%12)+12)%12];
    let cents=1200*Math.log2(f/targetFreq(items[cur]));
    if($('anyoct').checked)cents=((cents+600)%1200+1200)%1200-600;
    setN(cents);
    if(Math.abs(cents)<=TOL){
      off=0;if(!holdStart)holdStart=now;
      const p=Math.min(1,(now-holdStart)/HOLD);$('hold').style.width=(p*100)+'%';
      setMsg('Afinado! Segure…','var(--ok)');
      if(p>=1){
        status[cur]='ok';const hitM=midi(items[cur]);record(cur);cur++;
        holdStart=0;$('hold').style.width='0';noteStart=now;off=0;
        okSound(hitM);if(cur>=items.length){draw();finish()}else{draw();setMsg('Muito bem! Próxima nota.','var(--ok)')}
      }
    }else{
      holdStart=0;$('hold').style.width='0';
      if(now-noteStart>700){
        if(!off){off=now;offSum=0;offCnt=0}offSum+=cents;offCnt++;
        const r=rec[cur];if(!r.e&&now-off>2000){r.e=1;r.s=offSum/offCnt;r.c=1;draw()}
      }
      setMsg(cents>0?'Um pouco agudo — desça a afinação.':'Um pouco grave — suba a afinação.','var(--bad)');
    }
  }else if(holdStart&&now-lastSeen<200){/* falha breve */}
  else{off=0;holdStart=0;$('hold').style.width='0';$('heard').textContent='—';setN(null);if(cur<items.length)setMsg('Cante a nota destacada…')}
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
function ensureLoop(){if(running&&!loopOn&&!$('mod').classList.contains('hide')){loopOn=true;loop()}}

let sn=0;try{XP=+localStorage.getItem('solfejo-xp')||0}catch(e){}
(async()=>{try{DB=await claude.use('db');UP=await claude.use('user');if(UP)UID=await UP.id();pushRank()}catch(e){}})();
async function pushRank(){if(!DB||!UID||!XP)return;try{await DB.doc('rank/'+UID).set({xp:XP,les:MODS.filter((_,i)=>done(i)).length,t:Date.now()})}catch(e){}}
const esc=t=>String(t).replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]));
async function showRank(){
  $('home').classList.add('hide');$('rank').classList.remove('hide');const L=$('rklist');
  if(!DB||!UID){L.innerHTML='<p class="mute">O ranking online só funciona quando você está logado no Claude e o app foi compartilhado com você como colaborador. Seus pontos neste aparelho: <b>'+XP+' XP</b>.</p>';return}
  L.textContent='Carregando…';await pushRank();if(rkUnsub)rkUnsub();
  rkUnsub=DB.collection('rank').orderBy('xp','desc').limit(30).onSnapshot(async snap=>{
    const ids=snap.docs.map(d=>d.id);let ps={};try{ps=await UP.profiles(ids)}catch(e){}
    L.innerHTML=snap.docs.length?snap.docs.map((d,i)=>{const x=d.data(),p=ps[d.id]||{};return `<div class="rk${d.id===UID?' me':''}"><span class="pos">${['🥇','🥈','🥉'][i]||i+1}</span><b style="flex:1">${esc(d.id===UID?(p.name||'Você')+' (você)':(p.name||'Músico'))}</b><span class="mute">${x.les||0} lições</span><b>${x.xp} XP</b></div>`}).join(''):'<p class="mute">Ninguém pontuou ainda. Faça um exercício!</p>'},
    ()=>{L.textContent='Não foi possível carregar o ranking.'})
}
$('rkbtn').onclick=showRank;
$('rkback').onclick=()=>{if(rkUnsub){rkUnsub();rkUnsub=null}$('rank').classList.add('hide');$('home').classList.remove('hide');home()};
function setN(c){const n=$('needle');sn+=((c==null?0:Math.max(-50,Math.min(50,c)))-sn)*(c==null?.12:.22);n.style.transform='rotate('+(sn*1.7).toFixed(1)+'deg)';$('gauge').classList.toggle('in',c!=null&&Math.abs(c)<=TOL)}
/* ---------- Sons de interface (estilo console) ---------- */
function sfx(t){if(!(window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext))return;ac();const n=ctx.currentTime;
  const P={tick:[[1900,0,.035,.07]],ok:[[1568,0,.05,.1],[2349,.06,.09,.1]],back:[[1175,0,.05,.09],[784,.06,.08,.09]],hov:[[880,0,.09,.008]]}[t];
  P.forEach(([f,d,du,v])=>{const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain(),lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter();o.type=t==='hov'?'sine':'triangle';lp.type='lowpass';lp.frequency.value=5000;
    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f,n+d);o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(f*1.05,n+d+du);g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,n+d);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v,n+d+(t==='hov'?.025:.008));g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,n+d+du+.03);
    o.connect(lp).connect(g).connect(ctx.destination);o.start(n+d);o.stop(n+d+du+.05)});
  if(running)muteUntil=Math.max(muteUntil,performance.now()+(t==='hov'?60:160))}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button,select,summary');if(!b)return;sfx(b.id==='back'?'back':b.classList.contains('primary')||b.classList.contains('warm')?'ok':'tick')},true);
const HS='button,select,summary,label,.mod';
document.addEventListener('mouseover',e=>{const b=e.target.closest(HS);if(!b||b.disabled||!ctx||ctx.state!=='running')return;const r=e.relatedTarget;if(r&&r.closest&&r.closest(HS)===b)return;const n=performance.now();if(n-lastH<70)return;lastH=n;sfx('hov')});
document.addEventListener('pointerdown',()=>{ac()},true);
document.addEventListener('change',e=>{if(e.target.matches('input[type=checkbox],select'))sfx('tick')});
/* ---------- Modo ritmo ---------- */
function click(t,hi){const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();o.frequency.value=hi?1600:1100;g.gain.setValueAtTime(hi?.25:.1,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+.05);o.connect(g).connect(mg);o.start(t);o.stop(t+.06)}
function stopMetro(){if(mg){try{mg.disconnect()}catch(e){}mg=null}}
function goRhythm(){
  if(!running){setMsg('Ative o microfone na tela de módulos.');return}
  if(rt){setup(curStr,mode);return}
  ac();setup(curStr,mode);mg=ctx.createGain();mg.connect(ctx.destination);$('go').textContent='■ Parar';
  const bd=60000/+$('bpm').value,S=[],E=[];let t=4*bd;
  items.forEach(it=>{S.push(t);t+=BEATS[it.du]*bd;E.push(t)});
  rt={lb:-1,t0:performance.now()+50,bd,S,E,ok:items.map(()=>0),fin:-1,last:performance.now(),tot:t};
  const c0=ctx.currentTime+.05;for(let b=0;b<Math.ceil(t/bd);b++)click(c0+b*bd/1000,b<4);
  muteUntil=0;ensureLoop();
}
function rhythmTick(now,f){
  $('heard').textContent=f>0?CHROMA[((Math.round(69+12*Math.log2(f/440))%12)+12)%12]:'—';
  if(!rt){setN(null);return}
  const R=rt,e=now-R.t0,dt=now-R.last,n=items.length;R.last=now;
  const bt=Math.floor(e/R.bd);if(e>=0&&bt!==R.lb){R.lb=bt;const g=$('mas').querySelector('.bt');if(g){g.style.setProperty('--r',(bt%2?6:-6)+'deg');g.classList.remove('tap');void g.getBoundingClientRect();g.classList.add('tap')}}
  const j=e<0?-1:e>=R.tot?n:R.S.findIndex((s,k)=>e>=s&&e<R.E[k]);
  let cents=null;
  if(j>=0&&j<n&&f>0){cents=1200*Math.log2(f/targetFreq(items[j]));if($('anyoct').checked)cents=((cents+600)%1200+1200)%1200-600;if(Math.abs(cents)<=TOL)R.ok[j]+=dt}
  setN(cents);
  while(R.fin<j-1){const k=++R.fin,p=R.ok[k]>=0.55*(R.E[k]-R.S[k]);status[k]=p?'ok':'bad';rec[k].e=p?0:1;record(k)}
  if(j>=n){rt=null;$('go').textContent='▶ Começar';cur=n;draw();finish();return}
  if(j<0){setMsg('Prepare-se… '+Math.ceil(-e/R.bd),'var(--acc)');return}
  if(j!==cur){cur=j;draw()}
  setMsg(cents!=null&&Math.abs(cents)<=TOL?'Afinado! Sustente até o fim da nota.':'No ritmo: cante '+nameOf(items[j]),cents!=null&&Math.abs(cents)<=TOL?'var(--ok)':cents!=null?'var(--bad)':'var(--mute)');
  const ph=$('ph');if(ph)ph.setAttribute('width',Math.max(0,(WS[j]-4)*(e-R.S[j])/(R.E[j]-R.S[j])));
}
document.querySelectorAll('#rmode button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{rm=b.dataset.m;
  document.querySelectorAll('#rmode button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('sel',x===b));
  $('go').classList.toggle('hide',rm!=='rhythm');$('bpmw').classList.toggle('hide',rm!=='rhythm');
  if(curStr)setup(curStr,mode)});
$('tol').onchange=()=>{TOL=+$('tol').value};$('go').onclick=goRhythm;$('bpm').oninput=()=>$('bpmv').textContent=$('bpm').value;

/* ---------- Áudio ---------- */
function ac(){if(!ctx)ctx=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();if(ctx.state==='suspended')ctx.resume();if(!pLoad)loadPiano();return ctx}
async function loadPiano(){pLoad=1;try{const a=[];for(const b of PIANO){const u=Uint8Array.from(atob(b),c=>c.charCodeAt(0));a.push(await ctx.decodeAudioData(u.buffer))}PB=a}catch(e){PB=[]}}
function pianoF(fr,vol,dur){if(!PB.length||!ctx)return false;const m=69+12*Math.log2(fr/440),z=PZ.find(q=>m<=q[0]+.5)||PZ[12],t=ctx.currentTime+.01,sr=ctx.createBufferSource(),g=ctx.createGain();
  sr.buffer=PB[z[2]];sr.playbackRate.value=fr/f2m(z[1]);g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,t);g.gain.setTargetAtTime(0,t+dur,.15);sr.connect(g).connect(ctx.destination);sr.start(t);sr.stop(t+dur+1.2);return true}
function toneF(fr){
  ac();const T=performance.now()+1500;muteUntil=Math.max(muteUntil,T);noteStart=Math.max(noteStart,T);holdStart=0;off=0;$('hold').style.width='0';if(pianoF(fr,.8,1.5))return;const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();o.type='triangle';o.frequency.value=fr;
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,ctx.currentTime);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(.25,ctx.currentTime+.03);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,ctx.currentTime+1.1);
  o.connect(g).connect(ctx.destination);o.start();o.stop(ctx.currentTime+1.15);
}
function okSound(m){if(!ctx)return;const t=ctx.currentTime+.01,f=f2m(m+12),o0=ctx.createGain(),lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter(),dl=ctx.createDelay(),fb=ctx.createGain();lp.type='lowpass';lp.frequency.value=3200;o0.gain.value=.9;dl.delayTime.value=.13;fb.gain.value=.3;
 lp.connect(o0);o0.connect(ctx.destination);o0.connect(dl);dl.connect(fb);fb.connect(dl);dl.connect(ctx.destination);
 [[f,0,.16],[f*1.5,.09,.12],[f*2,.18,.07]].forEach(([fr,d,v])=>{const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();o.type='sine';o.frequency.value=fr;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t+d);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v,t+d+.05);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+d+.7);o.connect(g).connect(lp);o.start(t+d);o.stop(t+d+.75)});
 muteUntil=performance.now()+800}
function chime(final,m){
  if(!ctx)return;if(PB.length){pianoF(f2m(m),.7,.55);muteUntil=performance.now()+650;return}const t0=ctx.currentTime+0.01,b=m+12;
  [f2m(b),f2m(b+7)].forEach((f,i)=>{
    const t=t0+i*0.08,dur=0.55;
    [[1,.22],[2,.07],[3,.03]].forEach(([mul,vol])=>{
      const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();o.type='sine';o.frequency.value=f*mul;
      g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol,t+0.01);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
      o.connect(g).connect(ctx.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+dur+0.05);
    });
  });
  muteUntil=performance.now()+450;
}
function brass(m,t,du,v){
  const fr=f2m(m),g=ctx.createGain(),lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter();lp.type='lowpass';
  lp.frequency.setValueAtTime(900,t);lp.frequency.linearRampToValueAtTime(3200,t+0.08);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(v,t+0.03);g.gain.setValueAtTime(v,t+du*0.8);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0,t+du+0.12);
  lp.connect(g).connect(ctx.destination);
  [-6,6].forEach(c=>{const o=ctx.createOscillator();o.type='sawtooth';o.frequency.value=fr;o.detune.value=c;o.connect(lp);o.start(t);o.stop(t+du+0.2)});
}
function fanfare(big){
  if(!ctx)return;const t=ctx.currentTime+0.4;
  const S=big?[[60,0,.14],[64,.14,.14],[67,.28,.14],[72,.42,.38],[67,.86,.14],[72,1,.14],[76,1.14,.55],[72,1.75,.18],[76,1.95,.18],[79,2.15,.18],[84,2.38,1.4],[76,2.38,1.4],[79,2.38,1.4]]
    :[[60,0,.14],[64,.14,.14],[67,.28,.14],[72,.42,.8]];
  S.forEach(([m,dt,du])=>brass(m,t+dt,du,.08));
  muteUntil=performance.now()+(big?4800:2000);
}
function piano(m){if(pianoF(f2m(m),.8,Math.max(1,2.4-(m-48)*.03)))return;
  const t=ctx.currentTime+0.02,fr=f2m(m),dur=Math.max(0.9,2.6-(m-48)*0.03);
  const lp=ctx.createBiquadFilter();lp.type='lowpass';lp.frequency.value=Math.min(6000,fr*7);
  const master=ctx.createGain();master.gain.value=0.5;lp.connect(master).connect(ctx.destination);
  [[1,.55],[2,.32],[3,.2],[4,.12],[5,.07],[6,.04]].forEach(([k,a])=>{
    const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();o.type='sine';o.frequency.value=fr*k*(1+0.0003*k*k);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(a*0.5,t+0.006);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur/(1+0.35*(k-1)));
    o.connect(g).connect(lp);o.start(t);o.stop(t+dur+0.1);
  });
}
function stopSeq(){timers.forEach(clearTimeout);timers=[];hl=-1;playing=false;muteUntil=0;$('wupiano').textContent='🎹 Só ouvir o aquecimento';draw()}
function playSeq(){
  if(playing){stopSeq();return}
  ac();playing=true;$('wupiano').textContent='■ Parar';
  let t=100;
  items.forEach((it,i)=>{
    if(bars.includes(i))t+=280;
    const tt=t;timers.push(setTimeout(()=>{hl=i;draw();piano(midi(it))},tt));t+=620*(it.du===2?1.6:it.du===1?2.4:1);
  });
  muteUntil=performance.now()+t+2500;timers.push(setTimeout(stopSeq,t+900));
}

/* ---------- Eventos ---------- */

  if(tot<8){setMsg('Cante alguns exercícios antes: a revisão é montada a partir dos seus erros.');return}
  bat=null;bi=-1;scName=M.sc?M.sc[0]:'Maior';clef=M.clef||'treble';$('rectwrap').classList.add('hide');
  const r=genRev(M);setup(r.s,'rev');

['shownum','shownames'].forEach(id=>$(id).onchange=draw);
